theorems.name: Submission.whitney_gluing_local_structure
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (A : Set (Rn n)) (h : Rn n → ℝ) (ν : Rn n → Rn n) (ι : Type) (φ : ι → Rn n → ℝ) (p : ι → Rn n) (g : Rn n → ℝ), IsClosed A → (∀ i, ∀ x ∉ A, ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (φ i) x) → (∀ i, ∀ x ∉ A, 0 ≤ φ i x) → (∀ x ∉ A, ∃ s : Finset ι, ∃ V ∈ 𝓝 x, ∀ i ∉ s, ∀ y ∈ V, φ i y = 0) → (∀ x ∉ A, ∑ᶠ i, φ i x = 1) → (∀ x ∉ A, g x = ∑ᶠ i, φ i x * (h (p i) + inner ℝ (ν (p i)) (x - p i))) → ∀ x ∉ A, ContDiffAt ℝ 1 g x ∧ ∃ S : Finset ι, (∀ i ∈ S, 0 < φ i x) ∧ ∑ i ∈ S, φ i x = 1 ∧ g x = ∑ i ∈ S, φ i x * (h (p i) + inner ℝ (ν (p i)) (x - p i)) ∧ fderiv ℝ g x = ∑ i ∈ S, (φ i x • innerSL ℝ (ν (p i)) + (h (p i) + inner ℝ (ν (p i)) (x - p i)) • fderiv ℝ (φ i) x) ∧ ∑ i ∈ S, fderiv ℝ (φ i) x = 0 ∧ ∑ᶠ i, ‖fderiv ℝ (φ i) x‖ = ∑ i ∈ S, ‖fderiv ℝ (φ i) x‖
